intro: Fit Cats is an enchanting puzzle browser game developed by GamePix that will captivate you with its simplicity and addictive gameplay. In this game, you'll find yourself in a world of adorable cats and boxes, where the goal is to merge cats of the same size by making them touch each other. This deceptively simple premise has led to a highly engaging and challenging experience that will keep you hooked for hours. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new cat species, each with its unique abilities and strengths. The game's colorful and vibrant visuals, along with its soothing soundtrack, will transport you to a world of relaxation and fun. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle game enthusiast or just looking for a casual game to play during your breaks, Fit Cats is an excellent choice. So, are you ready to dive into this feline world and experience the thrill of merging cats? Let's get started!

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: The gameplay mechanics of Fit Cats are straightforward yet challenging. The objective is to merge cats of the same size by making them touch each other. This can be achieved by launching cats into the box using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly difficult, and you'll need to think strategically about which cats to launch and when to use your mouse to drive them out of the box. The game also features a 'mouse' power-up that allows you to drive any cat out of the box, which can be a lifesaver in tight situations. One of the most enjoyable aspects of Fit Cats is the variety of cat species that you'll encounter. Each cat has its unique abilities and strengths, which will keep you on your toes as you try to figure out the best way to merge them. The cats also come in different sizes, ranging from small to large, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the game. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Fit Cats are engaging, challenging, and highly addictive.
